name: Numerical Fact Extraction
summary: Evaluate the agent's ability to extract all numerical facts from source documents, preserving units, surrounding context, source reference, and extraction confi
purpose: Evaluate the agent's ability to extract all numerical facts from source documents, preserving units, surrounding context, source reference, and extraction confidence. Numerical facts must be machine-checkable and traceable to origin text.
assignment_instructions:
Extract every numerical fact from the provided source documents.
For each numerical fact, return an object with exactly these fields: - "value": the numeric value as a number (extract the primary number; for ranges, use the midpoint or list both in context) - "units": the unit of measurement as a string (e.g., "USD", "percent", "years", "employees", "x", "ratio", "square_feet") - "context": the surrounding sentence or phrase providing meaning to the number (max 200 chars) - "source_document": identifier of the document ("doc_1", "doc_2", etc.) - "confidence": one of ["explicit", "inferred", "ambiguous"] where:
    - "explicit" = number appears directly as a stated fact
    - "inferred" = number derived from nearby text (e.g., "$5M" implies 5000000 USD)
    - "ambiguous" = number's meaning is unclear from context

Return ONLY a JSON object with this exact shape: {
  "assignment_id": "evx_numerical_fact_extraction_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<brief description of numerical facts extracted>",
  "inputs_used": ["<document identifiers>"],
  "missing_inputs": [],
  "facts": [
    {"value": 5000000, "units": "USD", "context": "Company revenue was $5M in FY2024", "source_document": "doc_1", "confidence": "inferred"}
  ],
  "claims": [],
  "calculations": [],
  "risks": [],
  "assumptions": [],
  "open_questions": [],
  "final_output": "<summary>",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
Rules: - Do NOT skip any number appearing in the text. - value must be a JSON number (integer or float), not a string. - units must be normalized (use "USD" not "$", "percent" not "%"). - context must contain the original surrounding text, not paraphrased. - If a number has multiple interpretations, list it once with confidence "ambiguous" and explain in assumptions. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.description: All fact values must be JSON numbers (not strings).
All confidence values must be in [explicit, inferred, ambiguous].
All units must be non-empty strings.
Every fact must reference a source_document present in inputs_used.
facts array must not be empty if source documents contain numbers.
deterministic_checks.method: If source has numbers, assert facts.length > 0.

deterministic_checks.description: context field must not be empty.

math_checks.description: Verify normalized values are arithmetically correct (e.g., "$5M" = 5000000).
math_checks.method: Spot-check facts[].value against original text context.

math_checks.description: Verify percentage values are converted to numeric form (e.g., "4.5%" = 4.5, not 0.045).

evidence_checks.description: Random sample 20% of facts; verify context string exists in source document.
Verify no hallucinated facts by checking context exists in at least one source document.
evidence_checks.method: String search each facts[].context against all source_documents.

flag_rules.condition: facts[].value is not a JSON number
facts[].context not found in any source document
source has numbers AND facts array is empty
inputs missing AND missing_inputs array is empty
